name: 6959-longprompt-dsv2lite-1gpu
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite, the base checkpoint rather than -Chat because the requests are raw text continuations and the base repo ships no chat template. ~30 GB of bf16 weights, already in the local HF cache.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP off. One GPU, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM: 27 layers, MLA with kv_lora_rank 512 + qk_rope_head_dim 64, 16 heads, 26 MoE blocks of 64 routed + 2 shared experts at top-6, 15.7B total / 2.4B active, YaRN to 163840 positions.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=2, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 200 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over `/v1/completions`, single turn, no shared prefix between requests. Every request is a distinct 49152-token document -- fixed length, not a distribution -- asking for exactly 64 tokens back, `ignore_eos` on, temperature 0, seed 42. Roughly 768 prompt tokens per generated token: a document-ingestion shape.
purpose: A document-ingestion service completing 48K-token texts with 64-token continuations for two concurrent clients on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang 0.5.0rc2 at commit 704ced1b2ec45a87bb42494fe9da18fa5004e546. The interpreter is
# named by `configs/env.yaml: venv`. Host, port and served-model-name are owned by the
# serving layer and are deliberately absent; everything not written here is an engine default.
model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
trust-remote-code: true
tp-size: 1
attention-backend: flashinfer
chunked-prefill-size: 8192
context-length: 65536
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42
